In this video, I test OX Alpha across:

💻 **Web Development** — Can it build a complete, functional web project?

🎮 **Game Development** — Can it turn an idea into an actual playable game?

🧊 **3D Modeling** — Can it handle a serious 3D modeling challenge?

The goal isn't just to see what OX Alpha claims to be capable of.

**I want to see what it can actually DO.**

I'll be looking at the quality of the output, how well it follows instructions, how much fixing is required, and whether the final results are actually usable.
